definitions.explanation: The temporary suspension of transportation services such as trains, buses, or ferries, typically due to weather, accidents, or maintenance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{運休|うんきゅう}している。
examples.english: Trains are suspended due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{運休|うんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The bullet train service was suspended due to heavy snow.

examples.japanese: {運休|うんきゅう}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}できる→確認：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: Service suspension information can be checked on the app.

notes:
FORMATION: {運|うん} (transport) + {休|きゅう} (rest/suspension).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{運休|うんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (become suspended)
・{運休|うんきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (suspend service)
・{運休|うんきゅう}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (service suspension information)
・{運休|うんきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (suspensions are announced)
・⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧{運休|うんきゅう} (planned service suspension)
